01 / DANCE STYLES

What moves you?

Eight dance forms. One space. Many ways to move.

Bollywood
01 / 08

Bollywood.

Filmi energy, expressive faces and big, joyful choreography made for the spotlight.

Kathak
02 / 08

Kathak.

Storytelling through rhythm, spins and intricate footwork, rooted in north India.

Bharatanatyam
03 / 08

Bharatanatyam.

Precision, devotion and expressive gesture from South India's classical tradition.

Contemporary
04 / 08

Contemporary.

Fluid, expressive movement that explores emotion, weight and freedom.

Bhangra
05 / 08

Bhangra.

Powerful, celebratory Punjabi folk dance full of energy, rhythm and community.

Fusion
06 / 08

Fusion.

Where classical roots meet modern styles in choreography that surprises.

Hip Hop
07 / 08

Hip Hop.

Groove, rhythm and attitude. Street-born style built on musicality.

Folk
08 / 08

Folk.

Regional dances that carry harvest, community and celebration.

02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PRACTICE

Introducing
our cute founder.

The stage.
Ritika.
RITIKA ARORAFounder portrait
IMAGE PLACEHOLDER / 3:4

RITIKA ARORA

ARTIST. EDUCATOR. STORYTELLER.

I moved to London, UK in 2020 when I started Nrityaritika — a safe space for people wanting to learn, have fun with, or just experience something new through different forms of dancing.

Now, in 2026, we have successfully taught over 600+ students from all across London. And now, we have RADS by Nrityaritika!

The coolest, no-thinking space for my loved students. Just come, learn, have fun, and walk into every party with a bit more confidence.

Discover Ritika's journey
